comment: Every picture frame of Claude (0.5.0 adds blinkHalf, write, webSearch, skill and plug; 0.6.0 the 59 solo frames from tally0 on, the skits of a Claude minding background agents and the peek at a background shell): its name, its kind (solo: 70x40 logical pixels, a box of 8 cells by 2 rows; scene: 105x40, 12 cells by 2 rows, drawn only beside the spinner), the solo frame a scene is built on (drawn in its place wherever a scene cannot be, the team scenes excepted: sprite.ts footerOf), and the braille pose that stands in where the terminal has no graphics. scripts/make-frames.py draws one PNG per entry; hooks/lib/sprite.ts mirrors this table and a test holds the two together.

frames.name: idle
frames.what: standing, eyes open, relaxed

frames.name: idleUp
frames.what: the top of a breath: one pixel taller, arms a pixel higher

frames.name: blink
frames.what: eyes shut for a blink

frames.name: lookL
frames.what: eyes to the left

frames.name: lookR
frames.what: eyes to the right

frames.name: lookUp
frames.what: eyes up, pondering

frames.name: lookDown
frames.what: eyes down, concentrating

frames.name: armsIn
frames.what: arms tucked forward, as if typing

frames.name: stepA
frames.what: walk, first step

frames.name: stepB
frames.what: walk, second step, one pixel up

frames.name: hop1
frames.what: crouch before a hop: squashed, wider, legs bent

frames.name: hop2

frames.name: hop3

frames.what: right arm raised high, happy eyes

frames.name: wave2

frames.name: flinch

frames.name: cheer3

frames.name: yawn2

frames.name: sip1

frames.name: sip2

frames.name: sweat2

frames.name: clock1

frames.name: clock2

frames.name: pumpkin2

frames.name: sleep1
frames.what: asleep: settled low, eyes closed, a small z

frames.name: sleep2

frames.name: sleep3

frames.name: sleepCold2
frames.what: the same, breathing, the snowflake turned

frames.name: think2

frames.name: think3

frames.name: read1

frames.name: read2

frames.name: search3

frames.name: run3

frames.what: a small globe, its land at the left

frames.name: ask1

frames.what: the bubble a pixel higher, the arm tilted the other way

frames.name: work1
frames.what: a small gear at the right, Claude's arm on it

frames.name: work2
frames.what: the gear turned an eighth

frames.name: blinkHalf
frames.what: eyes half closed (4 px tall), the frame between open and shut

frames.name: write1
frames.what: a pale notepad page at the right with faint rules; a mauve pen held in his right arm at the start of the first line, one short ink stroke written

frames.name: write2
frames.what: the first line longer, the pen further right

frames.name: write3
frames.what: two lines written, the pen at the end of the second, a small ink dot

frames.name: webSearch1
frames.what: the globe as in web1 with the magnifying glass over its upper left

frames.name: webSearch2
frames.what: the globe turned a third, the glass over its middle, the land under it brighter

frames.name: webSearch3

frames.name: skill1

frames.name: skill2

frames.name: plug1
frames.what: a cable from his right arm ending in a plug a few pixels short of a wall socket at the right (surface-colored plate, two dark slots)

frames.name: plug2
frames.what: the plug in the socket, a small yellow spark at the join

frames.name: tally0
frames.what: the score paddle hanging from his right hand at his side, its plain pale blue back to us; his eyes glance down and right at it

frames.name: tally1
frames.what: his right arm up, the score paddle beside his head: a bold dark 1 on a light card in a blue rim; happy eyes, a blush

frames.name: tally2
frames.what: his right arm up, the score paddle beside his head: a bold dark 2 on a light card in a blue rim; happy eyes, a blush

frames.name: tally3
frames.what: his right arm up, the score paddle beside his head: a bold dark 3 on a light card in a blue rim; happy eyes, a blush

frames.name: tally4
frames.what: his right arm up, the score paddle beside his head: a bold dark 4 on a light card in a blue rim; happy eyes, a blush

frames.name: tally5
frames.what: his right arm up, the score paddle beside his head: a bold dark 5 on a light card in a blue rim; happy eyes, a blush

frames.name: tally6
frames.what: his right arm up, the score paddle beside his head: a bold dark 6 on a light card in a blue rim; happy eyes, a blush

frames.name: tally7

frames.name: tallyMany
frames.what: his right arm up, the score paddle beside his head showing 9+ in bold dark digits; happy eyes, a blush

frames.name: radar1
frames.what: eyes right on a small round radar scope on a short stand at his right (his right arm behind it): dark green screen, lighter rim, the bright sweep pointing up, the quarter it just swept glowing, the blip there flaring

frames.name: radar2
frames.what: the radar sweep a quarter turn on, pointing right, the next blip flaring and the last one fading

frames.name: radar3
frames.what: the radar sweep pointing down, the third blip flaring

frames.name: radar4
frames.what: the radar sweep pointing left over a quiet quarter, the blips dimmed; his eyes happy, content

frames.name: radio1
frames.what: a lavender headset on (a band over his head, an ear cup at our left with its lamp off, a mic boom to the corner of his mouth), sound arcs coming in by the cup; eyes up and to the left, listening

frames.name: radio2
frames.what: talking into the headset mic at the corner of his mouth: a small open mouth, two bold sound arcs going out beside it, the ear cup lamp lit red

frames.name: radio3
frames.what: copy that: happy eyes and a blush, the ear cup lamp green and a green check beside it

frames.name: report1
frames.what: a helper (a small Claude) coming in at the right edge, its arms up holding a white page over its head; he looks right

frames.name: report2
frames.what: the helper hopping beside him, the page held up to his right hand as he reaches out for it

frames.name: report3
frames.what: he holds the page up by his face on a raised forearm and reads it, eyes focused on it; the helper stands watching at his lower right

frames.name: report4
frames.what: a green check on the page and two yellow sparkles; he is pleased (happy eyes, blush), the helper hops on its toes, arms thrown up

frames.name: launch1
frames.what: a small rocket (white body, red nose and fins, a blue porthole) standing on the floor at his right; he looks at it

frames.name: launch2
frames.what: ignition: the rocket a few pixels up on a flame, smoke billowing at its base; his eyes wide, mouth open

frames.name: launch3
frames.what: the rocket leaving through the top right on its flame over a plume of smoke; he looks up after it, happy

frames.name: perch1
frames.what: a helper standing on his head, he a little lower and squashed under it, his eyes rolled up toward it

frames.name: perch2
frames.what: the helper hopping on his head, two spring marks under it; his eyes squeezed shut, squashed a pixel more

frames.name: conduct1
frames.what: conducting, eyes happy: a thin white baton raised up and out in his right hand; a sky and a pink music note at the upper left

frames.name: conduct2
frames.what: the baton swept down low, his mouth open in song; the notes a little higher and a new yellow one

frames.name: conduct3
frames.what: the baton up and in toward his head; the notes higher still

frames.name: juggle1
frames.what: juggling three balls (blue, green, yellow) in an arc over his head, a pale speed line behind the top one, the tip of his tongue out in concentration: his left hand up at a throw, the right low, eyes on the top ball

frames.name: juggle2
frames.what: juggling: every ball one spot further round, his right hand up at a catch, the left low

frames.name: juggle3
frames.what: juggling: the balls one spot further again, both hands halfway, leading back into juggle1

frames.name: gum1
frames.what: chewing gum: a small pink bubble at his mouth, heavy-lidded eyes, unbothered

frames.name: gum2
frames.what: a big pink bubble over his lower face, a white glint on it, eyes wide

frames.name: gum3
frames.what: the bubble popped: a splat of pink gum stuck over his mouth, dripping off his chin, flecks on his head and above his brow, short white burst marks ringing the splat, eyes squeezed shut

frames.name: popcorn1
frames.what: a red-and-white striped popcorn bucket at his right side, a dropped kernel on the floor, eyes to the upper left on the show, one kernel flying in from the bucket beside his open mouth

frames.name: popcorn2
frames.what: munching popcorn: happy eyes, a small chewing mouth, blush, the kernel gone

frames.name: plane1
frames.what: holding a white paper plane up at his right, looking at it

frames.name: plane2
frames.what: the throw: his right arm up, the plane leaving at the upper right with two short speed lines, happy eyes

frames.name: plane3
frames.what: the plane gone: he watches the upper right corner, pleased, a tiny sparkle where it left

frames.name: plane4
frames.what: the plane coming back in from the left edge at head height, his eyes wide, looking left, a small yellow exclamation mark

frames.name: plane5
frames.what: bonk: the paper plane stuck nose-first in the top left of his head, eyes squeezed, two small stars

frames.name: zen1
frames.what: meditating: eyes closed in calm curves, a small smile, floating with short legs, arms out to the sides, a small lavender twinkle at the upper left

frames.name: zen2
frames.what: meditating, one pixel higher, the twinkle now at the upper right

frames.name: plant1
frames.what: a small terracotta pot on the floor at his right with a sprout of two tiny leaves; he looks down at it

frames.name: plant2
frames.what: the same pot, a taller stem with two proper leaves

frames.name: plant3
frames.what: the plant taller still, a third leaf and a closed pink bud at the top

frames.name: plant4
frames.what: the plant in flower, pink petals round a yellow center, a sparkle; happy eyes, blush

frames.name: water1
frames.what: his right hand raised with a sky-blue watering can tipped over the sprout, three drops falling

frames.name: water2
frames.what: watering the two-leaf plant, the can tipped over it, three drops falling

frames.name: water3
frames.what: watering the budding plant, the can tipped over it, three drops falling

frames.name: water4
frames.what: watering the flowering plant, the can tipped over it, three drops falling

frames.name: lantern1
frames.what: holding a small red lantern at his right, lit, a warm yellow halo round it; eyes half-lidded, sleepy, a small yawn

frames.name: lantern2
frames.what: the lantern flickered low, its halo smaller and dimmer; his eyes shut for a moment

frames.name: lunch1
frames.what: holding a sandwich at his right (bread, green lettuce, red tomato), wide eyes on it

frames.name: lunch2

frames.name: term1
frames.what: a tiny terminal window at his right (light border, title-bar dots, a green prompt, a cursor block); he glances at it

frames.name: term2
frames.what: the same window, the cursor off and one more line of output
